source_text: Quaecumque dixerunt testes uniuersi priores In Christo fuerunt facta. Aut in altero dicant? Quod ipsum si cupiunt facere frustrantes in ore, Ipsi se subsannent, uideant cum plebem in illo. Quis fuit is iustus, de quo prophetae canebant, Cum nemo sit iustus in terris, nisi e caelo uenisset Dauid enim princeps peccauit amando puellam, Peccauit et Salomon; et tamen paenituit illos. Cum isti tam clari et insigni reges eorum Non fuerunt iusti, sed ipsi de iusto canebant, Nec quidem Esaias uates de se talia dixit, Qui fuit ab rege Manasse de serra secatus. Alter lapidatus, alter est mactatus ad aras, Alterum Herodes iussit decollari reclusum. Omnes iusti uates alia sunt morte perempti, Quod Dominus ligno pependit, uoce Moysi: 'Non quasi homo Deus suspenditur', intimat ante; 'Aut non ceu filius hominis minas patitur', inquit. Sic Dominus ipse cum uenisset, ista secutus: Oportet me, inquit, reprobari uoce Moysi. At ego non tota, sed summa fastigia carpo, Quo possint facilius ignorantes discere uera. Hi autem iniqui, <qui> subdole uiuere quaerunt, Iam semel cruenti perseuerant fingere uana. Infatuan<t> stultos maius euanescere dictis, Quod crucifixus, cum sic oporteret eundem. Sic enim disposuit propter primitiui ruinam; Non solum pro illo, et pro nobis uenit e caelo. Constituit populum nouum suo nomine firmum, Iuxta prophetias compleuit omnia Christus. Ecce noua facio, Esaias clamat in ipso, Et nemo priora reputet nec antiqua sequatur. Haec noua sunt hodie sub nostra lege profecta, gentes in Christo credi<di>mus dicto Moysi. Ille duos populos praedixerat esse futuros, Et quidem minorem populum praecellere dixit. Sed isti nequitiae pleni iam desperato furore: Lex nobis est data, dicunt, uos unde uenistis? Si nobis obsistunt, putant et resistere Summo, Qui uoluit nobis bonus esse .......
pass_a_gloss: Prophetae de Iusto canebant — nemo iustus in terris nisi e caelo. Dauid/Salomon peccauerunt. Vates morte alia — Dominus ligno. Populus nouus; Ecce noua facio. Duo populi — minor praecellit. Lex nobis / unde uos?
pass_b_english: Whatever all the earlier witnesses said was done in Christ. Or let them say it of another? If they want to do that very thing, cheating in the mouth, let them mock themselves — let them look with the crowd at him. Who was that just one of whom the prophets sang, when no one is just on earth unless he had come from heaven? For David the prince sinned by loving the girl; Solomon sinned too; and yet they repented. When these so famous and marked kings of theirs were not just, but themselves sang of the Just One, neither did Isaiah the seer say such things of himself — who was cut by the saw under king Manasseh. One was stoned, another slaughtered at the altars; Herod ordered another, shut up, to be beheaded. All the just seers were destroyed by other deaths — that the Lord hung on the wood, by Moses’ voice: ‘God is not hung like a man,’ he intimates beforehand; ‘or he does not suffer threats like a son of man,’ he says. So the Lord himself, when he had come, followed these: It is needful for me, he says, to be rejected by Moses’ voice. But I do not pluck all things, only the highest peaks, so that the unknowing may more easily learn true things. But these unjust, who seek to live by trickery, already once bloodstained, keep inventing empty things. They make fools more foolish by vanishing sayings — that he was crucified, when so it had to be for him. For so he arranged because of the first man’s ruin; not only for him, but for us too he came from heaven. He set a new people firm in his name; according to the prophecies Christ filled all things. Behold I make new things, Isaiah cries in him, and let no one recount former things or follow the old. These new things have gone forth today under our law; we nations believed in Christ by Moses’ saying. He had foretold two peoples would be, and indeed said the lesser people would excel. But those full of wickedness already in desperate rage: The law was given to us, they say; from where did you come? If they oppose us, they think they resist the Highest too, who willed to be good to us… ****** No earthly king is the Just One the prophets sang. Christ from heaven makes a new people; the lesser people excels — that is not ‘where did you come from?’
